task_instance: Attempt the skill's core deliverable: verify an existing AKS cluster context (step 1), install the AI Runway controller/CRDs (step 2), assess GPU hardware (step 3), and deploy a first model (step 5) against a real AKS cluster.
blocker_detail: The skill's Prerequisites explicitly require an already-existing AKS cluster ('This skill assumes an AKS cluster already exists'), and every step (kubectl context check, controller install, GPU node assessment, provider install, model deployment) operates against that live Azure-managed Kubernetes cluster via `az aks get-credentials` + `kubectl`/`make`. This sandbox has no Azure account, no Azure credentials, no `az` CLI, no kubeconfig, and no reachable AKS cluster (checked: `kubectl`/`az` not installed, `~/.kube` absent, no Azure/kube env vars set). A local substitute (e.g. a kind/minikube cluster) would not exercise the actual deliverable, since the skill's GPU-assessment and provider steps are specifically about real cloud GPU node pools reachable only via Azure. Additionally, the skill's own reference files (references/steps/step-1..6*.md, references/troubleshooting.md) that contain the actual step instructions are not present in the skill source (only SKILL.md and LICENSE exist), so even the procedural content needed to carry out each step is missing.
